_about: Rules you may change. The tam-mapper only plans and counts; it never spends.
_max_searches_per_plan: A plan bigger than this stops with a plain message. Use fewer places or keywords.
_expected_new_per_search: New businesses one search finds, used until real searches are done.
_expected_fit_rate: The share of businesses that fit, used until the website-classifier has checked some.
_pages_per_search: These two come from the google-maps-scraper's config.json when it is next to this skill.
